info.name: Migadu Password Sync
info.summary: Propagate Nextcloud password changes to Migadu mailbox passwords
info.description:
**Unified webmail login.** Every Nextcloud password change (personal settings GUI, admin panel reset, `occ user:resetpassword`, email reset link) — and user creation with a password — is pushed to the matching Migadu mailbox through the Migadu API. Webmail at `webmail.ronzz.org` then accepts the same NC credentials against Migadu IMAP — the NC account password *is* the mailbox password.
The mailbox is derived from the user's primary email address (`user@ronzz.org` → local part `user`); only addresses on the configured Migadu domain are synced. Sync failures never break the password change: they are logged at error level (divergence is visible in the Nextcloud log) and the next password change retries.
Configuration (system config, `occ config:system:set`): - `nc_migadu_password_sync_api_email` — Migadu admin account email - `nc_migadu_password_sync_api_key` — Migadu API key (Admin → My Account → API Keys) - `nc_migadu_password_sync_domain` — mail domain, e.g. `ronzz.org` - `nc_migadu_password_sync_exclude` — optional comma-separated NC user ids never synced (e.g. accounts whose email is a dummy, not a real mailbox)
Connectivity check: `occ migadu:test`.
